QuestInfo.name: Gesture of Good Will
QuestInfo.0: #p2152004# doesn't want to talk. See if there's any way you can win her over.
QuestInfo.1: #p2152004# will read the letter if you enter the Black Wings' mine and find the entrance to a specific laboratory. Start by finding the area #bBehind the Mine#k, in the direction of the #bEntrance#k.
QuestInfo.2: #p2152004# read the letter and said she'd think about it. There wasn't much more that you could do.

0.0: Keep your voice down! Are you trying to get the Black Wings' attention? Fine, I'll read the letter...if you do something for me first.

yes.0: You must be desperate. The job is simple enough: enter the Black Wings' mine and look for the laboratory there.
yes.1: Simple doesn't mean easy, though! But that's what it'll take to get me to read your letter.
yes.2: There's a cave hidden behind the mine. Just listen for Vi--I mean, #ba person's voice#k.

no.0: Then you won't mind if I just throw this away?

1.0: You don't look so good. Still, you found the lab. I'm impressed. Fine, I'll read your stupid letter.
1.1: A continental conference? It's not a bad idea, but we'd be fools to trust #p1101000#. Still, I'll talk to my compatriots. Maybe we can work something out.\r\n\r\n(You will be moved to Ereve after you accept.)

default.0: Haven't you gone to the mine yet?
